title: Q-SAYDO-rules-OPEN-STANDARDS-1: says OPEN-STANDARDS-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:OPEN-STANDARDS-1
**Status:** open

The system states `OPEN-STANDARDS-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation openstd --check: new bespoke format: instances/qnfo/dependencies.json (config file without $schema); declare the standard in doctrine/open-standards.json or meet it now; new bespoke format: instances/qnfo/foundation-l

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:OPEN-STANDARDS-1` exits 0.
